description: Replaces the program's price step with the rule printed in Hahnel (2021), p. 181: w = min(v, 0.25) * (1.05 - 0.5^v), with v this round's relative imbalance of the commodity, |2 * surplus| / (supply + demand). No lag and no floor. Line 719 binds delta, the step; the new text computes it from this round's surplus, supply and demand and from price-delta-to-use, which line 718 computes as 1.05 - 0.5^v. Every other line runs as committed. The formula is step_book in research/upstream/_price_rules.py.
